verdict.line: You lose if you let Sett sit on a full Grit bar and land empowered Knuckle Down (Q) autos while your W (Path Maker) is down; you win if you charge W into his engages and pull him off position with a 2-stack Ntofo Strikes (Q) shockwave before he can trade.

brief.thesis: Sett's E (Facebreaker) only stuns when enemies are on opposite sides of him — in an isolated 1v1 away from a minion wave it just slows, so his hard CC is conditional on wave state, not always-on. K'Sante's W (Path Maker) gives a telegraphed charge window with reduced damage taken that can eat his cooldowns and then stun-and-knockback him out of position, which lines up with K'Sante's measured solo-kill advantage in this matchup even though the overall shape sits at 50.3% over 2139 games.

theirWindow.when: Grit bar full, Q off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can expend Grit on Haymaker (W) for a shield plus center true damage, then chain two empowered Knuckle Down (Q) attacks. Back off the center of his punch and don't trade face-to-face until the bar resets.

yourWindow.when: Your W off cooldown, he engages
yourWindow.what: Charge Path Maker (W) into his commitment — the charge-up's reduced damage lets you absorb his burst, then the dash stun and knockback cancel his follow-up before his Grit shield comes online.

start.why: The standard pick at 50.7% over 2128 games and 83.6% pick rate — the extra early sustain holds up against Sett's alternating-punch passive chip damage.

boots.why: 84.7% pick, 50.7% win rate — flat damage reduction cuts into every auto in his Pit Grit punch cycle, including his empowered Q autos.

core.why: Adds a slow proc to your Q (Ntofo Strikes) trades, making it easier to land both hits for the 2-stack shockwave pull.

runes.keystoneWhy: Proc'ing Grasp every 4 seconds on short Q (Ntofo Strikes) trades heals you and grows bonus health, which is the exact trade pattern this matchup forces.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 75.4% of games at 49.3% win rate and lets you reset for waves after trades; Flash+Ignite (49.7% WR, 17.2% pick) is a fine swap if you want to convert the measured solo-kill advantage into an early kill.

playing.title: Trade behind minion walls
playing.detail: Sett's E (Facebreaker) only stuns when you're sandwiched between him and something else on the opposite side. Stay off the wave's second flank so a bad trade only slows you instead of locking you down.

playing.title: Save W to eat his Q burst
playing.detail: Charge Path Maker (W) right as he commits to empowered Knuckle Down (Q) autos — the charge's reduced damage absorbs the %max-HP hits, then the stun punishes him before his Grit shield comes online.

playing.title: Build Q stacks before committing
playing.detail: Land both Ntofo Strikes (Q) hits to trigger the 2-stack shockwave pull before going for a kill. Pulling him off position denies his own E setup and locks him in place for your damage.

playing.title: Don't chase low-HP Sett
playing.detail: His passive heals more the lower his health drops, so finishing a losing trade once he's under half health can backfire. Disengage with E (Footwork)'s shield instead of forcing the kill.

playing.title: Watch his Grit gauge before all-inning
playing.detail: Haymaker (W) only threatens once Grit is stored from damage he's taken. If he's been free-farming unharmed, his punch is weak — that's your window to initiate.

playing.title: Hold R for his all-in, not yours
playing.detail: Both ultimates sit on 120/100/80/80/80s cooldowns. Knocking him through a wall with All Out (R) right as he commits to The Show Stopper denies his burst outright.

playing.title: Itemize Steelcaps and Iceborn early
playing.detail: Plated Steelcaps blunts his alternating auto-attack passive, and Iceborn Gauntlet makes your Q (Ntofo Strikes) slow land more reliably in every trade.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and the 50.3% head-to-head win rate over 2139 games come from measured current-patch data; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the matchup.
